record.question: What is the purpose of using 'fizzing crystals' or gas during a double-contrast barium meal study?
options: To help the patient relax during the X-ray.
To coat the lining of the stomach with barium more effectively.
To distend the stomach with gas, allowing better visualization of the mucosal lining when coated with barium.
To speed up the passage of barium through the small intestine.
record.explanation: Answer C: To distend the stomach with gas, allowing better visualization of the mucosal lining when coated with barium.. Gas distends the stomach so barium coats and outlines mucosa for double-contrast evaluation. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/voidcysto; https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/safety-xray. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
